caseStudy.title: PerfectMatrimony
caseStudy.lead: A matchmaking app for an Indian client: members fill in a detailed profile, and the app searches the database and suggests partners whose details match, with the community and family preferences that matter in Indian marriages.

brief.title: The brief
text: Arranged and assisted marriages in India weigh more than age and city: community, language and family matter too. The client wanted an app that takes all of that into account.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the app around a detailed member profile.
Implemented searching the database and suggesting partners whose details match.
Used a festive design in bright colours, with traditional wedding imagery.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: Members get partner suggestions based on the details that matter to them and their families.
